title: Trump-Musk row could cost Tesla billions in crucial subsidies
text:
Elon Musk’s Tesla faces the loss of billions of dollars in government subsidies following his explosive fallout with Donald Trump after the president cut state support for green industries.
Subsidies have been central to Tesla’s rise from upstart manufacturer to the world’s largest EV producer in less than 20 years, but analysis by Sky’s Data & Forensics team reveals the president’s cuts could leave a significant gap in its future earnings.
